They wear a cream loose work jacket over a cobalt top, wide terracotta trousers and oversized navy sneakers. One hand places a single cream sheet into the folder; the other steadies its side. Two cream sheets already peek out, displaying only one navy circle and one terracotta rectangle as bold graphic artwork, no lettering or fake writing. A warm small smile and focused dot eyes.
